name: Oasis Startup Hub
summary: Oasis Startup Hub is a government-backed programme that helps early-stage tech companies set up and grow in Dubai. It offers subsidised licences, office space and introductions to government and corporate buyers.
what_they_want: A steady flow of credible, venture-backed startups that will hire locally and add to the emirate's tech economy.
what_we_get: Fast-tracked licensing, subsidised desks and warm introductions to government pilot customers for our portfolio companies.
trade: We route our new ventures through Oasis for setup, and Oasis gives them priority licensing and pilot introductions.
priority: High: the quickest route to licences and first government customers for our UAE launches.

name: Falcon Cloud
summary: Falcon Cloud is a regional cloud and AI infrastructure provider with data centres in the UAE. Its startup programme gives young companies cloud credits and technical support.
what_they_want: Fast-growing AI companies that build on its platform early and become long-term enterprise customers.
what_we_get: Cloud and GPU credits, local data residency and architecture support for every new venture.
trade: Our ventures standardise on Falcon Cloud from day one in exchange for credits and dedicated technical support.
priority: High: compute is our ventures' biggest early cost, and local data residency matters to regional customers.

name: Dune Ventures
summary: Dune Ventures is an Abu Dhabi-based early-stage fund investing in technology companies across the Gulf. It writes seed and Series A cheques and supports founders with hiring and expansion.
what_they_want: Early access to strong, de-risked deal flow in AI and software.
what_we_get: A co-investment partner and warm investor access when our ventures raise their first rounds.
trade: We give Dune early looks at our ventures before they raise, and Dune considers leading or joining their seed rounds.
priority: Medium: valuable at fundraising time, less urgent before ventures have traction.

name: Najd Innovation Authority
summary: Najd Innovation Authority supports startups and SMEs in Saudi Arabia with funding programmes, licensing help and access to government procurement.
what_they_want: Startups that create local jobs and bring new technology into the Saudi market.
what_we_get: Market-entry support, grants and procurement access for ventures expanding into Saudi Arabia.
trade: We expand selected ventures into Riyadh with local hiring plans, and the Authority provides soft-landing support and procurement introductions.
priority: High: Saudi Arabia is our ventures' largest expansion market and the Authority shortens entry.

name: Thames Launchpad
summary: Thames Launchpad is a London accelerator that helps international startups open their first UK office. It runs a 12-week programme with mentors, investors and corporate partners.
what_they_want: Ambitious international startups ready to enter the UK market.
what_we_get: A structured UK entry path for our ventures, with mentors and investor introductions.
trade: We send UK-ready ventures to Launchpad's cohorts, and Launchpad offers our MENA network to its alumni expanding to the Gulf.
priority: Medium: useful for ventures with UK traction; not every venture is ready.
